q: How many squeezes did the writing hand make in trial 1?
Calculate the percentage drop for the writing hand from trial 1 to 5.
Squeezes fall each trial: muscles tire because they run short of oxygen and lactic acid builds up.
Suggest why the writing hand did better, and how to improve the investigation.
Its muscles are trained by daily use. Improve: more people, rest between hand tests, the same peg, a partner counting.
